text:
morgan: Weird bug — async client sometimes double-POSTs on 504 when using default retry machinery. Repro in sample app.
jiang: Can you paste the config? sounds like body got consumed before replay.
morgan: here's minimal snippet:
```py
client = AsyncClient(retries=2, timeout=6, in_flight_semaphore=4, idempotency_header='X-Idempotency-Key')
await client.post('/items', json={'name':'x'})
```
ben_devx: If the body is a stream it won't be rewindable. But for json dict we serialize each try. Are you seeing actual duplicate resources created?
morgan: yes, 2 resources, only when upstream returns 504 then fast fail + retry. Logs show we're sending ephemeral id keys that change per retry.
lina_qa: is the SDK regenerating idempotency key on retry? That would explain it.
jiang: We have a race with semaphore timeout: semaphore acquires then client times out, aborts request but the in-flight lock release triggers a retry path that constructs a fresh idempotency key. So non-idempotent replays.
ben_devx: Ugh. So two issues: body rewinding and idempotency-key lifecycle while request is in-flight. Proposed fix: make idempotency key generation part of the request preparation, not per attempt, and ensure the request body is buffered/cloned when necessary.
morgan: Agree. Also request-level hook 'on_prepare' would help customers add stable keys.
jiang: Can we change default to reuse idempotency key if header present? currently our devex lib regenerates on each attempt.
ben_devx: Feature request: add params: prepare_once=True, preserve_body_on_retry=True, retry_on_status=[502,503,504], and on_retry callback. Also adjust typing: AsyncClient.request signature should return AsyncIterator[Response] when streaming — typing pr incoming.
lina_qa: Test plan: reproduce with mock upstream returning 504 then 200; assert single create and same idemp-key header across attempts. I'll write an integration test.
ci-bot: CI run started for branch fix/retry-idempotency — pytest 12/12 passed so far :rocket:
morgan: For quick workaround, set retries=0 and handle retry in app with explicit idempotency key.
ben_devx: I'll open a PR to: 1) make idempotency key stable per request, 2) add preserve_body option, 3) add docs sample. Ping me if sample app needed.
jiang: Also log trace id and retry_count at debug to help reproduction.
lina_qa: thanks. please tag me on the PR. :thumbsup:
